title: Structural index cohort refresh uses manual operator publication lane
summary: After main advances, structural index may lag until operator runs platform-intelligence:structural-cohort-refresh --apply; audit inSyncCount compares to latest origin/main.
retrievalQuestions: Why is structural index INDEX_BEHIND_REMOTE after a successful publish?
What commands refresh the PI structural index cohort on Ryzen?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Suite indexing health shows BEHIND_REMOTE or inSyncCount zero after publication
doNot: Claim cohort current from a single-repo publish receipt alone
Treat inSyncCount zero during long runs as publish failure without checking target SHA
proveBeforeClaiming: indexRunId VERIFIED for target repo SHA
trigger audit after batch with documented moving-head policy
